title: HP High Court Directs State To Return Land Given For Government School After Closure Due To Zero Enrolment
description: The Himachal Pradesh High Court has held that the State cannot continue to retain land provided for the establishment of a government school after the very purpose for which it was given has been abandoned. Observing that the Education Department could not retain possession of the land following the closure of the school due to zero student enrolment, the Court directed the State to restore possession to the landowners.
